title: Going to Town: Henry Jones, Bingie Madison, Red Allen and Crawley
summary: Barbarin identifies saxophonist Henry Jones and clarinetist Bingie Madison and debates Rex Stewart versus Red Allen on trumpet. He also names the clarinetist Crawley on Snake Up Dance.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
